headline: HSY Q2 Deep Dive: Supply Chain Progress and Innovation Offset Commodity Volatility
summary: Chocolate company Hershey (NYSE:HSY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.6% year on year to $2.79 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.90 per share was 33.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
